from: September book, night 18 (Here Am I; Send Me)
p1: In the year King Uzziah died, Isaiah saw the Lord in the temple. The Lord sat high up on a king’s throne.
Heavenly helpers named seraphim called out, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord! The whole earth is full of His glory.”
Isaiah felt very small. “My lips are not clean,” he said. “I have seen the King, the Lord!”
p2: Then a seraph touched Isaiah’s lips and said his sin was taken away. Now Isaiah was clean and ready. The Lord asked, “Whom shall I send?” Isaiah said, “Here am I; send me.” The Lord Isaiah saw was Jesus.
You can be the Lord’s helper too. When someone needs help, raise your hand high. Say, “Here am I!”
old: One day, the prophet Isaiah had an amazing experience. In a beautiful vision, he saw Heavenly Father’s shining throne, high and glorious, filling the temple with light.
Bright angels flew all around, singing, “Holy, holy, holy!” Everything felt so wonderful and full of Heavenly Father’s love.
Isaiah felt very small, but an angel gently touched his lips with something warm and bright from the altar. Right away, Isaiah felt clean and ready, and his worries floated away.
Then Isaiah heard Heavenly Father ask, “Who will go and share My message with My people?” Isaiah didn’t wait even a moment.
“Here am I! Send me!” Isaiah said bravely. He was ready and willing to help Heavenly Father. When Heavenly Father needs a helper, we can be brave and say, “Send me!” too.
